responsibility: Owns rs6000-specific expansion of low-level block and string-style memory operations. It decides when fixed-size block clears and block moves should be inlined versus left to library calls, chooses scalar, AltiVec, VSX, vector-pair, or length-qualified load/store sequences based on size, alignment, overlap, endianness, and target capabilities, and provides helper routines for compare-oriented loads, so this file is the backend’s main implementation of efficient PowerPC memcpy/memset-style RTL expansion.
